notes: Merged-record problem on XPCC itself: the alias list includes 新疆生产建设兵团融资担保有限公司 ('XPCC Financing Guarantee Co., Ltd.'), a separate company. The LEI 300300Z6012165000091 and company number 916500007291577150 most likely belong to that company rather than to the Corps, which is a state body (inferred, not verified against GLEIF).

Tianshan Aluminum Group's record carries aliases of Shimge Pump Industry Group / Zhejiang Shimge Pump (新界泵业). This reflects Tianshan Aluminum's 2020 reverse listing into the Shimge shell, but a user searching for the pump maker would land on a UFLPA-listed aluminium producer.

Xinjiang Guannong Tomato Products' record merges the parent Xinjiang Guannong Fruit & Antler (Guannong Fruit Velvet Group) aliases; the XPCC Sixth Division record merges 'Cotton and Linen Company of the Sixth Division'.

Subsidiaries: the affiliate endpoint returned 91 records, which collapse to 50 unique entities because most appear twice (once from 'Sanctions list' ownership data, once from 'Tradeverifyd Legacy Data Model'). Tianye, Urumqi Xishan Garment Factory and Qingsong Building Materials appear only in legacy data; Ecoone, First/Second/Seventh Divisions, Xishan Prison and Xinjiang University of Technology appear only in sanctions-list data.

All 25 subsidiaries looked up carry at least one flag; none has zero. But 24 of 25 carry only 'Forced Labor Research' badges; only Tianshan Aluminum also has UFLPA. None inherits XPCC's OFAC, BIS or CBP WRO designations in this data, even though OFAC's 50% rule would in practice cover majority-owned entities.
Xinjiang Tianye Group (chemicals/PVC) carries only 1 research flag and no recorded trade relationships.
The 25 subsidiaries not looked up (mostly regiment-level gins and cotton processing plants) have annotation_count and badges set to null; this is not a clean result.

Xinjiang Zhongtai Group is UFLPA-listed (2023-06-12) but is not linked to XPCC by any affiliate record; Xinjiang Zhongtai Import & Export has no designations and no affiliate link to Zhongtai Group was checked. Its buyers include Russian polymer firms and Sanhua (Vietnam). Zhongtai Group's PVC buyers include Apollo Hospitals Enterprise (India). No Western brands appear among the buyers retrieved (first 15 of 28 and 15 of 42).
China Xinjian Group was not found by name search (closest hits were unrelated: China Xinyuan, China Yanjian, China Xinlian).

XPCC's own trade footprint is thin: 1 supplier and 1 buyer. The supplier 'CN COTTON STATEOWNED FARMS GROUP' looks like a generic placeholder name from shipping data (country-prefixed, no aliases or IDs) and carries no flags.

Downstream (out, depth 2): only one flagged path, XPCC -> Xinjiang Tianshan Textile Co. (raw cotton 520100; UFLPA + research). Tianshan Textile's only buyer is Zhejiang Huafu Top Dyed Melange Yarn, which was not flagged in the path results.
OFAC designations have no date in the data. tia_quick_check reports screening status 'not_screened'; the designations listed are platform-attached annotations, not a screening run.
No parent entities are recorded for XPCC.
